governed-folio.full_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one isolated photographic paper object assembly for an animation material sprite, on genuinely transparent background. Straight-down 90-degree overhead orthographic camera, no perspective convergence or camera tilt. A landscape open double-pocket archival folio, two equal adjacent bounded compartments separated by a clear central crease, both holding one blank ivory insert whose upper two-thirds are visible and printable. Natural off-white cotton paper, subtle dense fibers, slightly irregular cut edges, shallow thickness, gently used but immaculate. One small muted burnt-rust fabric-paper authorization tab fastens only the LEFT pocket edge; RIGHT pocket remains independent and untouched. A very slight sage lining may show at the left pocket. All faces perfectly blank, no printing, no lines, no symbols, no letters, no text or logos, no navy marks: semantic printing will be composited later. Soft upper-left studio illumination, narrow soft contact shadows beneath physical edges only. Match high-end tactile archival stationery product photography, neutral cream rather than yellow or dark beige; matte not glossy. Folio lies flat square to frame, horizontal and vertical edges aligned, no diagonal rotation. Center the entire assembly in a square canvas, leave 10 percent transparent margin on every side; complete silhouette with nothing clipped. At least 1254px square if possible. No desk, ground plane, scenery, vector look, CGI, cardboard toy, collage decoration or drawn connectors.

governed-folio.meaning: Two bounded record domains share one open folio; a physical authorization tab is confined to left domain. Coded role/authority/correction semantics must distinguish permitted side without implying the paper itself is a person or agent.

governed-folio.integration_caution: Generated raw alpha includes faint outer fringe/specks beyond opaque body. Use the alpha>=200 body bbox for nested-SVG crop, excluding exterior noise and transparent padding, as in the accepted sprite pipeline. Do not use raw-alpha canvas extents for geometry or port placement. Never treat shadow as material border.
